title: gpu-pcf-conjectures: three continued fractions found by GPU search (one conjecture, two cases of a proved family)
description: Three polynomial continued fractions found by a GPU search (RTX 5090), matching 1/(π−3), 2/ln(27/16) and 3/ln(1024/729) to about 220 digits. Version 1.1.0: the last two are proved. They are the cases k = 2, 3 of an infinite family given by Euler's continued fraction of the series Σ 1/(m(2m−1)k^(2m−1)), with value k/((k−1)ln(k−1)+(k+1)ln(k+1)−2k ln k), checked to about 128 digits for integer and real k and in exact arithmetic. The first, for 1/(π−3), remains a numerical conjecture and does not have this structure; it is not in Cohen (arXiv 2304.11727), the Ramanujan Machine paper (Nature 2021) or the public LIReC database (827 entries, checked 24 November 2026). Includes the search code, positive and negative controls, negative results and two corrections of version 1.0.0.
